description: Shared superset of trusted-channel security scenarios. Go and Rust tests consume the matrix according to explicit implementation applicability; their trust chains are not identical.

vectors.name: version_pid_mismatch
vectors.scenario: Router /version returns a PID that does not match the expected PID from manager state.

vectors.name: version_deployment_mismatch
vectors.scenario: Router /version returns a deployment_id that does not match the expected deployment from manager state.

vectors.name: version_protocol_mismatch
vectors.scenario: Router /version returns a management_protocol_version that does not match the expected protocol.

vectors.name: process_identity_mismatch
vectors.scenario: The live process at the expected PID does not match the expected binary path or start time.

vectors.name: non_loopback_address
vectors.scenario: The listen address is not a loopback address (e.g., 10.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0).

vectors.name: redirect_response
vectors.scenario: The server responds with a 3xx redirect to any request in the trust chain.

vectors.name: connection_close_after_version
vectors.scenario: The server sends Connection: close in the /version response, requiring a redial for /health or authenticated request.

vectors.name: protocol_upgrade
vectors.scenario: The server responds with 101 Switching Protocols or an Upgrade header.

vectors.name: timeout_during_version
vectors.scenario: The /version request times out beyond the connect/handshake timeout.

vectors.name: cancel_during_generation
vectors.scenario: The user cancels an in-progress generation request.
vectors.go_reason: Generation cancellation belongs to the Rust image data plane; Go trustedrouter only fetches model catalogs.

vectors.name: redial_attempt
vectors.scenario: The connection drops after /version and the client attempts to establish a new connection for the authenticated request.

vectors.name: health_not_ok
vectors.scenario: The /health endpoint returns a status other than 'ok'.
vectors.go_reason: The Go catalog channel has no /health step; the Rust image credential path intentionally adds this gate.

invariants: Authorization is sent only after each implementation's declared trust chain passes on the same TCP connection; Rust image requests additionally require /health status ok.
Any failure in the trust chain closes the connection and never sends the API key on a new connection.
Redirect, proxy, and protocol upgrade are never followed.
The listen address must be loopback (127.0.0.0/8 or ::1).
Connection: close from the server invalidates the channel; no redial is attempted.
